title: Hetzner DDNS Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Hetzner Cloud DNS dynamic DNS client

global.description: Global settings that apply to all zones

api_token.description: Hetzner Cloud API token (can use ENV:VAR_NAME syntax)

ip_check_url.description: URL to check current public IP address

check_interval_seconds.description: How often to check for IP changes (in seconds)

ttl_default.description: Default TTL for DNS records (in seconds)

sync_mode.description: additive: only create/update configured records, never touch anything else (lets you manage extra records manually in the Hetzner console). strict: the tool tries to make Hetzner match the config exactly, reporting (and, once confirmed, removing) records that exist on Hetzner but not in the config.

strict_confirm_delete.description: Only used when sync_mode is 'strict'. While false (default), extra records found on Hetzner are only logged as warnings and never deleted. Set to true once you've reviewed the warnings to let the tool actually delete them. SOA and NS records are never deleted regardless of this setting.

zones.description: List of DNS zones to manage

sync_mode.description: Overrides global.sync_mode for this zone only. Lets you run some domains in 'strict' mode and others in 'additive' mode.

strict_confirm_delete.description: Overrides global.strict_confirm_delete for this zone only. Only relevant when this zone's effective sync_mode is 'strict'.

records.description: DNS records to manage in this zone

mode.description: dynamic-ip: use current public IP; static: use fixed value

ttl.description: TTL for this record (overrides global default)
